Everything here is free. No paywall.
★ Like it? Star us on GitHub

Other catalogs charge from US$ 19 a year to US$ 49 for lifetime access to live data. Here everything is free. Prices checked on 2026-11-18.

Catalog last audited on 2026-11-23. How we count →

Bring your own provider accounts. These are third-party free tiers, not a token grant from OmniRoute. Sign up, get credentials where a provider asks for them, and connect the ones you can use. Each provider sets its own limits, availability and terms.

Stacking free tiers by hand means dozens of SDKs, dozens of rate limits and no clear idea of what you have left. OmniRoute keeps 214 catalog rows with free access and computes the real figure from 12 pools with a published quota, each shared pool counted once. Quotas that only open after a regional identity check (today, ModelScope) are shown apart, +~6M behind regional identity verification, and never added to the real figure. What is left shows up on the dashboard (/dashboard/free-tiers).

Animated summary of the live /dashboard/free-tiers page. How each figure is counted: docs/reference/FREE_TIERS.md#how-we-count.

Catalog last audited on 2026-11-23. The figures move both ways. A provider ends a free tier and the real number drops. A new one lands and it climbs. We publish what the catalog computes, never a rounded-up best case.

Install, connect a provider, then route through one endpoint

# After connecting a provider, create your OmniRoute key in Dashboard → API Keys:
curl http://localhost:20128/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_OMNIROUTE_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"auto","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello!"}]}'

auto needs an eligible route. A fresh installation can have no eligible keyless targets, and a keyless provider may reject third-party clients. Providers marked tos: avoid, including Kiro, are excluded from automatic routing by default; connecting an account does not override that setting. See the Free Tiers Guide before choosing a provider.

Copy-paste quickstart scripts for Python, Node.js, PHP and cURL: examples/quickstart/. Step-by-step version: Quick Start.

Kimi
Moonshot AI

 Thanks to Kimi (Moonshot AI), our founding Open Source Friend, for backing this project! Kimi is the AI lab behind the open-weight K2 and K3 model families — Kimi K3 delivers a 1M-token context window, native vision and frontier-level coding at a fraction of closed-model prices, and works out of the box with Claude Code, Codex and every coding tool OmniRoute serves.

What Kimi's support powers: Kimi's API credits power OmniRoute's AI-validated release pipeline — the merge validation powered by Kimi K3 stage that reviews every pull request before it ships — plus day-to-day feature development. First-class Kimi support ships on both rails: the direct Kimi API (kimi-k3) and the Kimi Code coding plan (OAuth and API key). OmniRoute is also the first Brazilian open-source project in Kimi's support program. Get a Kimi API key with 15% extra credits →

skills.name: green-prs
skills.description: Use when the owner wants several chosen PRs (a pasted list, or the analyzed plan-files) made green against today's base before merging: 'deixa essas PRs verdes', 'pre-green'. Repairs proven PR defects with contributor credit and reports PASS/PARTIAL/BASE-RED per PR. One PR with review threads: /baby

skills.name: merge-batch
skills.description: Use when the owner pastes PR numbers and wants each landed as its own merge, with no plan-files: 'mergeia essas: #A #B #C'. Star table, one shared board to find conflicts, then each PR is admitted on its own checks (merge-gates §9). To land the group as ONE pull request with merge commits: /merge-tr

skills.name: merge-prs
skills.description: Use when analyzed plan-files exist in `_tasks/pipeline/prs/1-analyzed/` and the owner asks to merge the reviewed queue: 'roda o merge-prs', 'mergeia o que foi revisado'. Shows the readiness report, takes the owner's choice and dossier OK, then lands each PR through merge-gates §9. Pasted list, no pl

skills.name: quality-scan
skills.description: Use when the owner asks for an ad-hoc sweep of the static quality gates ('roda os gates', 'quality scan', 'como estão os ratchets?'). Runs `npm run quality:scan` (or `--fast`) on a pinned SHA and reports failed, not-run and frozen debt. Read-only, static gates only. For tests and build on a release

skills.name: sweep-reds
skills.description: Use when CI is red across the queue or the 'Release branch not green' issue is open: 'varre os reds', 'a base está vermelha', 'destrava a fila'. Repairs the base first, in its own PR, then takes the red PRs one at a time, separating inherited failures from PR defects. A chosen PR list on a healthy b

skills.name: validate-release-green
skills.description: Use when the owner asks whether a release branch or a combined PR candidate is green before a release or a merge ('está verde?', 'pré-flight da release', 'roda o release-green'). Runs the local Release-Green observer (static gates plus tests, optional build) and separates HARD, DRIFT and incomplete

skills.name: cli-a2a

skills.name: cli-backup-sync

skills.name: cli-batches
skills.description: Submit and monitor batch inference jobs from the CLI. Upload and manage files for batch processing, retrieve results, and integrate batch pipelines with CI/CD workflows.

skills.name: cli-chat
skills.description: Send chat completions, stream responses, and start an interactive REPL session from the CLI. Supports all OmniRoute providers, combo routing, and system prompt configuration.

skills.name: cli-compression

skills.name: cli-contexts
skills.description: Manage context engineering configurations, RTK filter sets, and conversation sessions from the CLI. Apply context-relay settings and inspect active context pipelines.

skills.name: cli-cost-usage
skills.description: View cost breakdowns, token usage, and call logs from the CLI. Filter by provider, model, or date range. Export usage reports and inspect per-connection spending.

skills.description: Create and run evaluation suites, watch live benchmark progress, view scorecards, compare model performance, and integrate eval runs with CI workflows from the CLI.

skills.name: cli-health
skills.description: Check server health, component status, and live metrics from the CLI. Run `health`, `health components`, and `health watch` for a real-time dashboard of circuit breakers and provider status.

skills.name: cli-keys
skills.description: Create, list, rotate, and revoke OmniRoute API keys from the CLI. Manage OAuth flows for provider authentication and inspect key scopes and expiration.

skills.name: cli-mcp
skills.description: Inspect the MCP server status, list registered tools and scopes, run tool invocations, and manage MCP audit logs from the CLI.

skills.name: cli-models
skills.description: Query available AI models, list model aliases, and browse the full model catalog from the CLI. Filter by provider, search by capability, and resolve model name variants.

skills.name: cli-plugins-skills

skills.name: cli-policy-audit
skills.description: Inspect audit logs, manage access policies, view telemetry data, and review request history from the CLI. Filter by event type, user, or time range for compliance workflows.

skills.name: cli-providers
skills.description: Manage provider connections from the CLI: list available/configured providers, add, test, test-all, validate, rotate API keys, and view per-provider metrics.

skills.name: cli-resilience
skills.description: Inspect and manage circuit-breaker states, connection cooldowns, quota limits, and backoff levels from the CLI. Reset stuck providers and configure resilience thresholds.

skills.name: cli-routing
skills.description: Create, list, update, and delete routing combos from the CLI. Test routing strategies, inspect combo metrics, and configure fallback chains interactively.

skills.name: cli-serve
skills.description: Start, stop, and restart the OmniRoute server from the CLI. Manage daemon mode, port configuration, auto-recovery, system tray integration, and the dashboard open shortcut.

Discover community skills across many tool and provider categories, evaluate relevance with heuristic scoring, check for malware or hardcoded secrets,
